title: Who is at work right now

cues.text: Read the live board: who is in the mall, who is late or outside the circle, and what each person did last.
Attendance & activity opens on the live board. It refreshes itself every thirty seconds.
The counters: in the mall, late, not in yet, on a break, outside the circle, app closed and on leave.
Each counter is a filter. Late today shows only the people who came in late.
Everyone brings the whole team back.
A card per person: their shift, when they clocked in and how long they have worked so far.
Where their phone was at the last update: inside or outside the circle, and how far from the centre.
Last activity is the latest thing they really did: clocking, a patrol scan, a work order or a page in the office.
The light on the photo: green active in the last fifteen minutes, amber up to an hour, red longer.
Who is where puts everyone clocked in on the mall's circle, north up and to true scale.
Alerts from the last two days: late starts, people who left the circle, forgotten clock-outs and new phones.
